text: こども　あいてに　たたかっても　しょうきんは　たまらねえ！

structure.jp: こども　あいてに　たたかっても
structure.en: even if I battle against kids

structure.jp: しょうきんは　たまらねえ！
structure.en: the prize money doesn't pile up!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても after a verb means 'even if' that happens. たたかっても = 'even if I battle'.

patterns.name: 〜を相手に
patterns.explanation: A person plus あいてに means 'with that person as your opponent'; the を is dropped here. こども　あいてに = 'against kids'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is a rough, tough-guy way of saying ない 'not'. たまらねえ = 'doesn't pile up'.
